events.title: Microsoft and 11 More Stocks That Were Unfairly Punished After Earnings
events.body: Over the long-term, the stock market is very good at valuing companies. Not every stock price reaction to recent earnings reports seems fair. Through midday trading on Monday, more than 500 companies in the had reported quarterly results.
